title: Workbench Item
description: Single entry in workspace.md. Every entry describes one thing you need to do or attend to. Modules (calendar / board / quick-create) are views over this same entry pool - there is no separate task table.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reuse. Format: 8 lowercase hex chars.

uid.description: UID in the external calendar (CalDAV / ICS). Preserved across sync so editing locally does not create a duplicate on the server. Empty on pure-local entries (id is used as UID then).

kind.description: Entry type. 'task' = something to finish; 'event' = something to attend. A task with a start time shows up in BOTH the board and the calendar.

start.description: Start datetime in LOCAL time, no timezone suffix. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.

end.description: End datetime in LOCAL time, no timezone suffix. Must be after start.

remind.description: Reminder time in LOCAL time, no timezone suffix (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss). Empty = no reminder. Stored as an absolute timestamp so all-day entries and due-only tasks have no hidden offset rules.

done.description: Completion state. Only meaningful for kind=task.

recurrence.description: RFC 5545 RRULE subset. Supported: FREQ=DAILY | WEEKLY | MONTHLY | YEARLY, plus BYDAY (MO,TU,WE,TH,FR,SA,SU), BYMONTHDAY (1-31), INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL.

list.description: 所属清单（类似待办应用的「列表」）。空值表示收件箱 —— 快速捕获、尚未归类。清单不需要预先创建，由条目聚合得出。

parent.description: 父条目 id，用于子任务。子任务本身也是普通条目，只是多指向一个父级 —— 这样 md 里所有条目保持平铺，单条改动不牵连整棵树。

project.description: Project or category this entry belongs to.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of creation. Read-only for AI tools.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last modification. Read-only for AI tools.
